files.asrText: I dress the way I do because I like to be an individual. I don't think you should judge people by their clothes, though. It's only part of who they are. Sometimes I think about whether my clothes match, but it usually depends on if I'm going out somewhere special. Then I make an effort, but otherwise I just put on whatever I feel like.
